result_dir.description: The directory used to save results. Corresponds to --resultdir.

num_runs.description: Number of runs for each trace. Corresponds to --num-runs.

mount_options.description: Mount options to iterate through. Corresponds to -o. List of strings.

always_options.description: Options added to every trace. Corresponds to -a. List of strings.

tags.description: Tags to mark new traces. Corresponds to -t. List of strings.

server_path.description: The NFS server and export path to test against. Corresponds to <server:path>.

workloads.description: Workloads to run. Corresponds to [workloads...]. List of strings.

serial_graphs.description: Generate graphs inline while generating reports. Corresponds to --serial-graphs.

rand.description: Randomize the order of traces. Corresponds to --rand.
